facts.fact: The adwave.com guide '15 Explainer Video Styles That Work (2026)' lists 15 explainer video styles and was published on 2026-07-07.
facts.quote: Title: 15 Explainer Video Styles That Work (2026)

facts.fact: According to adwave.com, an explainer video 'style' combines two decisions: the visual treatment (such as animated or live-action) and the narrative angle (such as problem-solution or testimonial).
facts.quote: A "style" is really two decisions stacked together: the visual treatment (animated, live-action, text-driven, and so on) and the narrative angle (problem-solution, comparison, testimonial, and so on).

facts.fact: adwave.com states that no single explainer video style is best and that the right choice depends on the message, the audience, and where the video will live.
facts.quote: The explainer video style that works best is the one that fits your message, your audience, and where the video will live. There's no single "best" look.

facts.fact: adwave.com defines whiteboard animation as a style in which a hand appears to draw illustrations on a whiteboard in real time as the narration unfolds.
facts.quote: A hand appears to draw illustrations on a whiteboard in real time as the narration unfolds.

facts.fact: adwave.com defines a screencast explainer style as a recording of an actual screen, app, dashboard, or website with narration explaining what is happening.
facts.quote: A recording of an actual screen, an app, a dashboard, a website, with narration explaining what's happening.

facts.fact: Wavemaker turns a script into an AI storyboard using one of 21 storyboard presets, which steer the visual style of the video.
facts.quote: Wavemaker writes the script and turns it into an AI storyboard using one of 21 presets.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the vendor says is enough to create a first video.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's free plan gives you 75 credits, which is enough to create your first video, exporting at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan exports video at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan exports at 480p with a watermark, which is handy for testing a style before you commit.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's paid plans remove the watermark and export up to 4K resolution.
facts.quote: Paid plans remove the watermark and go up to 4K, so your homepage explainer looks as sharp as everything around it.

facts.fact: Each chat-based refinement in Wavemaker costs a few credits and takes a couple of minutes.
facts.quote: Each refine costs a few credits and takes a couple of minutes, so you can nudge the style until it matches what you pictured.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, most Wavemaker videos generate in about two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos generate in about two to five minutes to begin with.

facts.fact: Wavemaker exports 16:9 for websites and YouTube, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, and 1:1 and 4:5 for feed posts.
facts.quote: 16:9 for your website and YouTube, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, plus 1:1 and 4:5 for feed posts.

facts.fact: The article states that most explainer videos land between 30 and 90 seconds regardless of style.
facts.quote: Most explainers land between 30 and 90 seconds regardless of style.

facts.fact: The article calls sixty seconds the workhorse length for product and how-it-works explainer videos.
facts.quote: sixty is the workhorse length for product and how-it-works videos

facts.fact: The article describes the four-beat explainer script as problem, solution, how-it-works, and call to action.
facts.quote: the four-beat script (problem, solution, how-it-works, call to action)

facts.fact: The article's how-it-works explainer style typically uses three to five sequential steps.
facts.quote: usually three to five steps, that shows the machinery behind the promise.

facts.fact: The article lists problem-solution as style number 15 in its list of explainer video styles.
facts.quote: ### 15. Problem-solution

facts.fact: Wavemaker's paid plans allow users to design a custom voice to match their brand for voiceover.
facts.quote: on paid plans, you can design a custom voice to match your brand

facts.fact: Adwave says users can create their first explainer video free with 75 credits, with no credit card required.
facts.quote: Create your first video free with 75 credits, no credit card required.

facts.fact: The Adwave page presents 15 explainer video styles.
facts.quote: Now that you've seen all 15, you can choose with intent
